name: AlignEnum
description: Enumeration of align values for UI elements (used for align-items and align-self properties).

staticFields.label: Auto
staticFields.description: Auto: uses the parent's align-items value.

staticFields.label: FlexStart
staticFields.description: FlexStart: aligns items to the start of the cross axis.

staticFields.label: Center
staticFields.description: Center: aligns items to the center of the cross axis.

staticFields.label: FlexEnd
staticFields.description: FlexEnd: aligns items to the end of the cross axis.

staticFields.label: Stretch
staticFields.description: Stretch: stretches items to fill the cross axis.
